gemini-3.5-transcribe is a dedicated transcription model (audio only, no prompt). General models such as gemini-3.8-flash use the prompt. Tap “Test connection” to load the models your key can use.
*-transcribe model: speaker recognition can use Gemini native diarization or Hybrid. On-device + Prompt is locked (this model accepts no prompt or attachments).
General model: speaker recognition can only use On-device + Prompt. Gemini native diarization and Hybrid are locked (cloud speaker separation needs a *-transcribe model).
Comma-separated, e.g. vi-VN, en-US. Empty = auto-detect.

The app paces chunks to stay under the limit and avoid 429 errors. Per-model limits are set on the Quota tab.

When the current model runs out of quota (429), is overloaded, is blocked by Google\'s filters or does not exist, the app sends that chunk to a fallback model instead of failing the whole file. A model that has used up its daily quota stays locked until Google resets it.
Overload or per-minute 429: attempts before switching model

Chunks are cut at the quietest point near each mark so no word is split. With speaker recognition on a *-transcribe model, a chunk can be at most 30 minutes.
Changes here apply to files processed later; chunks already sent are not resent.
Video files are processed just like audio: the app extracts the audio track, then runs the clean-up, chunking and transcription.
Videos often contain multiple audio tracks (lapel mic, room mic, camera sound). Selecting the right track gives the cleanest transcript.
When off, such videos are reported as errors instead of skipped.

Speaker separation often splits the main speaker into two people when they move closer to or further from the mic. Rule 1 gives short pieces sandwiched by the same speaker back to that speaker; rule 2 gives turns of a secondary speaker who says very little nearby back to the main speaker. In exchange, a very short isolated question may be merged into the main speaker — turn this off if questions go missing.

Rule 2: secondary speaker talks less than (s, 0 = off)

Software and models bundled in Guzz. Tap an item to read the full license.

The audio of the files you choose is sent to Google AI Studio with your own API key, under Google\'s terms; Guzz sends it nowhere else. Audio cleaning and speaker detection run on the phone. Guzz has no ads and collects no usage data. Transcripts, settings and logs stay on the phone.
Tells general models how to transcribe when speaker recognition is off. Applies from the next file.
Only used by On-device diarization + prompt. {speakers} is replaced with the names of the speakers in the chunk. Applies from the next file.
The selected model (%1$s) is a *-transcribe model: it takes no prompt, so this can\'t be edited. Choose a general model on the Google AI page to use prompts.
The prompt has no %1$s: the model will not know the speaker names in the chunk.
